skills.name: Charity
skills.text: Lu Su can choose to draw an additional two cards. If he has more than five cards afterward, Lu Su must give half of his hand, rounded down, to a character with the least number of hand cards.

skills.name: Alliance
skills.text: Once per turn, Lu Su can discard X cards to force two characters to exchange hands, where X is the difference in the number of hand cards between the two characters.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
